attributes.purpose: PingAccess product adapter (arc .3.5, prefix pa): protected applications, resources, sites, virtual hosts, web sessions (OIDC relying party linked to the oidc-client integration), identity mappings (linked to edge header contracts), rules/rule sets and held-as-is objects (environment-bound flagged), named by name with ${pingaccess-id:<collection>/<name>} references; Admin API v3 reads and export importers; read-only Auditor collector; per-environment requests.json render with render notes; check_pingaccess planner check; every vendor form in api.py (unverified for 9.1.1).

attributes.description: An access gateway's protection of web applications <-> record (milestone 6.1a, task 537, design approved by master 2026-10-15): opsdir-adapter-pingaccess (arc .3.5, prefix pa). Import: Admin API v3 GET responses (pingaccess/admin-api, also reads its own requests.json back) and a saved /config/export (pingaccess/export): applications+resources, sites (targets -> backend role), virtual hosts (host -> service role), web sessions (OIDC RP, linked to the oidc-client integration by client id), header/JWT identity mappings (linked to edge header contracts), rules/rule sets (policy by name), everything else held as is (environment-bound flagged); secrets withheld whole, export key material dropped. Collector admin-api (Auditor basic or bearer; GET allowlist, paging while pages are full). Render per environment: pingaccess/admin-api/requests.json (${pingaccess-id:<collection>/<name>} placeholders) + render notes. Planner check_pingaccess (sign-in, references, bindings, engines in target, fixed sites, header contracts, environment-bound objects). Every vendor form in api.py, unverified for 9.1.1.

attributes.name: collection
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "path", "type": "str", "description": "collection path relative to the API base"}]
attributes.purpose: The api.Collection declared at an Admin API path, or None

attributes.name: usable_name
attributes.purpose: Whether a PingAccess name can name an entry and a reference (no DN special character, no slash)

attributes.name: type_slug
attributes.purpose: A collection path as an RDN value ('/' as '.')

attributes.name: held_base
attributes.purpose: Container DN of a collection's held-as-is objects: ou=<slug>,ou=held,ou=pingaccess

attributes.name: entry_dn
attributes.purpose: DN of a PingAccess object of a kind (resource below its application, held below its collection container)

attributes.name: reference
attributes.purpose: How settings name an object: ${pingaccess-id:<collection>/<name>}

attributes.name: resources_path
attributes.purpose: The collection path of an application's resources, the application named by reference

attributes.name: referenced
attributes.purpose: (collection, name) a ${pingaccess-id:...} reference names, or None

attributes.name: marked
attributes.purpose: Settings with every secret marked SEALED: a hidden field's value (ciphertext dropped), a secret-named setting's value

attributes.name: withheld_settings
attributes.purpose: Settings with what is or may be secret replaced by None, and the JSON Pointers withheld

attributes.name: credential_value
attributes.purpose: What an environment renders for an entry's withheld values: ${secret:<ref>} of its credential role, UNBOUND:<role>, or ${withheld}

attributes.name: filled
attributes.purpose: Settings with an entry's withheld values as the environment gives them

attributes.name: response_items
attributes.purpose: A collection response's items ({items:[...]} or a list), or a settings object as its one item

attributes.name: is_render
attributes.purpose: Whether a JSON document is this adapter's rendered requests.json

attributes.name: admin_api_read
attributes.purpose: Read of saved Admin API v3 responses (pages joined, resources given their application) and of rendered requests.json

attributes.name: export_read
attributes.purpose: Read of saved configuration exports: sections mapped to collections, nested resources hoisted, encryption material dropped and named

attributes.name: host_role
attributes.purpose: The binding role a host is in the record (service name, external host, database, or rendered UNBOUND:<role>), or None

attributes.name: object_name
attributes.purpose: An object's record name: settings for a settings object, <role or host>:<port> for a virtual host, else its name field

attributes.name: mapped
attributes.purpose: The value with fn applied to every leaf at a field path ('*' any list item or member)

attributes.name: leaves
attributes.purpose: The leaves of a value at a field path

attributes.name: placeholders
attributes.purpose: The (collection, name) of every ${pingaccess-id:...} reference in a value

attributes.name: resolved
attributes.purpose: The Objs of a Read's items: named, ids replaced by references, uses and unresolved ids listed

attributes.name: target_endpoint
attributes.purpose: (host, port or None) of a site target host:port (a rendered UNBOUND:<role>[:port] too)

attributes.name: imported
attributes.purpose: Imported of a Read: entries per kind (roles for hosts, integration and issuer for sessions, header contracts for mappings, held objects marked), groups per collection read, notices

attributes.name: read_admin_api
attributes.purpose: Importer pingaccess/admin-api: Imported from saved Admin API responses and the adapter's rendered requests

attributes.name: read_export
attributes.purpose: Importer pingaccess/export: Imported from a saved configuration export

attributes.name: version
attributes.purpose: The PingAccess version an environment's servers record (admin node's, else an engine's)

attributes.name: entries_of
attributes.purpose: The record's entries of a collection, in record order (resources after their application)

attributes.name: site_targets
attributes.purpose: A site's targets in an environment from its backend role's bindings (host order), or UNBOUND:<role>[:port]

attributes.name: body
attributes.purpose: An entry's request body for an environment: settings with secrets filled, name, hosts/targets from bindings, context root, client id from the integration

attributes.name: request
attributes.purpose: One entry's Admin API request: a settings PUT, or a PUT to <collection>/${pingaccess-id:...} creatable by POST

attributes.name: rendered
attributes.purpose: (Collection, entry) of everything the requests hold: every collection but the environment-bound ones

attributes.name: environment_bound
attributes.purpose: (Collection, entries) of the environment-bound objects the record holds (never rendered)

attributes.name: missing_references
attributes.purpose: The ${pingaccess-id:...} references in an entry's settings naming an object the record doesn't hold

attributes.name: problems
attributes.purpose: What the requests can't do as rendered: withheld secrets without credential role, missing references, unbound roles

attributes.name: admin_api_files
attributes.purpose: {pingaccess/admin-api/requests.json: text} for an environment (nothing when the record holds nothing to render)

attributes.name: render_env
attributes.purpose: Adapter.render_env: PingAccess's configuration for an environment

attributes.name: render_notes
attributes.purpose: Adapter.notes: render notes as data (unverified requests, environment-bound objects to create, withheld secrets, server profile and node files not rendered)

attributes.name: pages
attributes.purpose: Page requests of a collection so far: page 1, then the next while the last came back full and differs from the one before

attributes.name: api_steps
attributes.purpose: Collector steps: /version, each settings object and collection (paged), then each application's resources; GET allowlist only

attributes.name: source_problems
attributes.purpose: Why the collection sources can't be read (unbound credential/trust anchor, no location, a scheme other than basic/bearer)

attributes.name: session_problems
attributes.purpose: Why a web session can't sign users in: unknown client, unknown issuer, token endpoint auth not registered, PKCE required but not sent

attributes.name: header_fix
attributes.purpose: Fix recording a header contract (identity, set by pa-engine, trusted by the backend server roles) for a header an identity mapping sets

attributes.name: check_pingaccess
attributes.purpose: Planner check: web sessions (client, issuer, token endpoint auth, PKCE, implicit login), withheld secrets, missing references, virtual host and site roles, engines in the target, fixed sites (external-host fix), headers without contracts (header-contract fix); environment-bound objects reach the plan as the render note instead

attributes.name: site_listeners
attributes.purpose: Listeners the engines reach through sites naming a backend service name role

attributes.name: listeners
attributes.purpose: Adapter.listeners: engine 3000, admin 9000 and 9090, 9095 from 9.1, agents 3030 and sideband 3020 when held, and the sites' backends

attributes.name: key_pairs
attributes.purpose: VersionChange.touches: the key pairs the record holds, for PingAccess server roles

attributes.name: applies
attributes.purpose: Adapter.applies: whether an environment runs PingAccess (servers or Kubernetes)
